name: Skeleton
description: Where content will be, while it is being fetched.

props.name: lines
props.description: How many bars to draw. Default `1`; past that the last one is short, the way a paragraph's last line is.

props.name: circle
props.description: A round placeholder — an avatar, a thumbnail. `width` sets its size and the height follows.

props.name: label
props.description: What is loading, for a reader. It makes the skeleton a `role="status"` with the words in it, so put it on the one skeleton that stands for a region and leave it off the rest — a screen of placeholders each announcing itself is a screen nobody can listen to.

a11y: `aria-hidden` unless `label` is given, and then `role="status"` naming what is on its way.
